research_question: Can pseudo-building support and core-ring contrast improve raw P3 semantic damage segmentation without instance labels?
frozen_backbone: P3 including RGB/SAR encoders, localization head, fusion and original damage head

variants.m1_readout_finetune: same-step trainable copy of P3 damage readout
variants.m2_local_adapter: parameter-matched local 5x5 context inside LocCC support
variants.m4_core_ring_region: same adapter/support, core token and core-minus-ring contrast

primary_metric: raw semantic valid_mIoU on standard-ML Val450
automatic_rule: 500-step pilot; continue to 3000 only if all preregistered checks pass
